title: Backport Trakt show-link fix to Sonarr v4
body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [x] I have searched the existing open and closed issues

### Current Behavior

Sonarr 4.0.20.3014 still generates Trakt links using:

https://trakt.tv/search/tvdb/{tvdbId}?id_type=show

Clicking the Trakt button on a series page leads to an error page following Trakt’s website changes.

The v5 development branch already includes a fix in commit 3a487c1, replacing the TVDB search URL with:

https://trakt.tv/shows/{imdbId}

Could this fix be backported to v4 so users of the stable release can use the Trakt button without upgrading to v5?

### Expected Behavior

The button opens the corresponding show on Trakt.

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Open a series page in Sonarr 4.0.20.3014.
2. Click the Trakt button.
3. Trakt displays an error page.

### Environment

```markdown
- OS: Fedora KDE PLASMA
- Sonarr: 4.0.20.3014
- Docker Install: Yes
- Using Reverse Proxy: No
- Browser: Brave 1.96.61 (Official Build) (x86_64)
- Database: Sqlite 3.53.4
```

### What branch are you running?

Main

### Trace Logs

Not applicable: this issue concerns the external URL generated by the series page’s Trakt button. Clicking it opens Trakt’s website, which displays an error page; no Sonarr server operation fails.

The generated URL in Sonarr 4.0.20.3014 is:
[https://trakt.tv/search/tvdb/{tvdbId}?id_type=show](https://trakt.tv/search/tvdb/%7BtvdbId%7D?id_type=show)

The relevant code change already exists in commit 3a487c1:
https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/commit/3a487c1

This report requests backporting that change to v4. I can provide browser console output if needed.

### Anything else

_No response_
